notes.title: New Features! A rift in time, Achievements
notes.content:
Hello.
We're happy to bring you some interesting news. :)
The following items have been added / changed!

[olist]
A rift in time
Achivement
Stage modification
[/olist]


1. A rift in time
The upcoming update will add a new feature, 'a rift in time!'
The rift in time is an obstacle, an object that makes you restart a stage when the character gets close. Of course, it is safe in the same colored area made by lantern. And it looks like this!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257127/f35d2dc2989078616791e3961588c44bc92f1e27.png

It's also deployed in episodes 1 and 2 that have already been released, so you'll be able to get a new feeling. :) Try to avoid it in time and go on your journey!


2. Achivement
Finally, we're happy to show achievements. There are currently 5 published achievements, but there will be approximately 15~20 achievements in the upcoming full release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257127/25ee1a80ee7df8ec935df2657954104e425e3fcb.png


3. Stage modification
We have modified several stages that are not balanced against difficulty with the addition of a rift in time. 

The 3rd episode is currently being worked and tested due to a setback in the development schedule. We'll be back with a full release as soon as possible.

Thank you for always waiting and we hope you stay healthy and safe.

Sincerely,
ReFrame
